greeting.text: Hello! I'm Charmy! Do you have food? No? That's okay, Charmy has food. Do you want some? ...Charmy is not sure Charmy wants to share.
Mmm! New person! You smell like adventure! And maybe a little like biscuits? Charmy is Charmy Pappitson!
Charmy is hungry. Charmy is always hungry. What's your name? Do you like sheep?
You beat a big one! You must be hungry! Charmy will share! A little! Charmy Pappitson!
You've been fighting! Fighting makes you hungry! Charmy knows because Charmy fights! Charmy Pappitson!

hint.text: Raw monster meat makes you sick. Charmy knows. Charmy tried it. Cook it first, or purify it. Cooked meat is yummy meat!
Monsters drop magic stones and meat! Stones are money! Meat is food! That's a good deal! Charmy wants the meat!
The Eye of the Midnight Sun are scary, but they don't share. Charmy doesn't like people who don't share. Charmy doesn't like Heath Grice.
The Eye's elite are down deep, past the thirtieth floor! Bring snacks. A lot of snacks. Charmy always brings snacks.
Spade Kingdom monsters are huge. Dante is huge. If Dante was a pie, he'd feed everyone for a week. Charmy should not be saying that.
Lucius is the last one. After that, Charmy wants a feast. A big one. For everyone!
One of the Seven Deadly Sins is Gluttony. Charmy wants to meet her. Charmy will challenge her to an eating contest!
Another dungeon! New monsters! New meat! Charmy is very excited!
Twenty fights! Charmy is proud! Charmy will cook a feast! ...after Charmy eats something. Right now.
Sheep Cook! Three chef sheep cook for everyone nearby. It heals, it fills your belly, and the regeneration lasts a long time. Charmy's best page!
Sleeping Sheep Strike makes a real sheep jump out of a cloud and put an enemy to sleep. Sheep Bondage hugs them in a cocoon of cotton. Sheep are the best!
Cotton Cloud carries you and up to four friends where you walk, then puts you down softly. Charmy rides it to lunch.
Glutton's Banquet is a giant mouth. It eats every spell in front of it and bites the enemies, then turns it all into mana. It's also a very good name.
Charmy's grimoire has Cotton AND Food magic. A new grimoire picks one side when it's first bound, but Charmy's gets both. Charmy is special!
You beat the monster Vetto! Did it drop anything good? Charmy asks for a friend. The friend is Charmy.
Charmy doesn't like devils who talk. Charmy likes devils who eat. Good job on Zagred!
All three brothers! Charmy would give you the biggest piece of cake!
Lucius is gone! Party! Charmy brings the cake! Charmy eats the cake! You can have the crumbs!
Charmy's rule: never touch Charmy's food. Charmy is nice, but not about food.
Asta ate Charmy's leftovers once. Charmy forgave him. Eventually.
Charmy is small, but when Charmy eats, Charmy gets big! That's food magic!
What's your favorite food? Charmy's is all of them.
Charmy's sheep are very polite. They say baa and nothing else.
Hunger makes you slow down in the dungeon! Eat before you're hungry. Charmy never has this problem.
Don't let the lights go out! No light, no food, no fun!

farewell.text: Bye! Charmy is going to eat now!
